text: {"lessons":["A winning position can still have room to grow; I should avoid selling solely to lock in a gain and weigh the stock’s outlook against my portfolio needs.","A few months of account movements are not enough to judge my decisions; I should assess each trade by its rationale and risk, not short-term results.","Before adding shares, I should check concentration and available cash, and make sure each purchase fits a diversified, long-term plan."]}
